pages.text: An organism does what its grafts tell it to. Place a graft on its flesh.$(br2)A $(l)Tap$() lets the stored essence out: fill a vial from it, or set a jug in front of it and it fills the jug by itself.
A $(l)Leech Tendril$() drains the organism's essence from every creature within four blocks. A pen of leashed cows around a Density organism is, I admit, a strange sight. It is also a farm.
pages.title: Leech Tendril
Heart
pages.text: A $(l)Heart$() grafted on pumps. Every Heart makes the organism's $(l)Taps$() push essence faster, into a jug or down the veins: twice as fast with one, up to four times with three. A fourth does nothing; the veins cannot carry more.$(br2)Cows, pigs and sheep sometimes leave a $(item)heart$() worth keeping.

pages.title: Eye
pages.text: An $(l)Eye$() watches. While a creature is within four blocks of it, it gives a $(l)redstone signal$(). A $(l)comparator$() against it reads how full the organism is.$(br2)A door that opens for the cows. A lamp that lights when the store is low. It never blinks.
